name: SMARDEX USDN
oneLiner: USDN is SMARDEX's wstETH-backed synthetic dollar, held near $1 by protocol long-side mechanics targeting delta-neutral exposure on a two-step oracle flow.
collateral: Synthetic dollar backed by the SMARDEX USDN vault, initially using wstETH as the underlying asset and protocol long-side mechanics to target delta-neutral exposure
pegMechanism: Users mint USDN by depositing supported underlying assets into the USDN vault and redeem by burning USDN for the corresponding underlying asset value. Mint and redemption flows can be temporarily restricted by protocol imbalance and use a two-step oracle validation flow.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Freeze-only re-review: the verified USDN token source has no confirmed address freeze or blacklist function, but privileged MINTER/REBASER roles plus protocol mint/redemption flow restrictions represent a direct mutable holder-facing control surface. This explicit Possible override also prevents false Upstream inheritance from the unrelated Noble USDN symbol.

mintAuthority.summary: USDN uses non-enumerable OZ AccessControl. The SMARDEX USDN vault contract (0x656cb8c…) holds both MINTER_ROLE and REBASER_ROLE. The vault's owner() is a 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 (0x1e3e1128…) on Ethereum with no modules and no guard.

controls.label: SMARDEX USDN vault (MINTER_ROLE + REBASER_ROLE holder)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x656cb8c6d154aad29d8771384089be5b5141f01a) returned true; hasRole(REBASER_ROLE, same) returned true. Vault implementation at 0x271df5517a4daacb7cab988aa64d23debda4c498 (177-byte proxy). USDN constructor takes (minter, rebaser) args — both passed as address(0) at deployment (creation bytecode confirmed), then roles are set separately via the vault. Usdn.sol mint() and mintShares() require MINTER_ROLE.

controls.label: SMARDEX governance Safe (2-of-3) — vault owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295207, owner() on the USDN vault (0x656cb8c…) returned 0x1e3e1128f6bc2264a19d7a065982696d356879c5. getOwners() returned 3 signers; threshold() = 2. masterCopy slot 0 = 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552 (Gnosis Safe v1.3.0). getModulesPaginated returned empty; guard slot 0x4a20…c4c7 = 0x0.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183/25295207: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, vault 0x656cb8c…) = true; hasRole(REBASER_ROLE, vault) = true. Vault owner() = 0x1e3e1128… (2-of-3 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 on Ethereum).
